summary: Iteration 106 - Full verification of GSTIN-as-username retailer login. 15/15 backend pytest cases pass (login by GSTIN, legacy body-field aliases, legacy username allowlist, email rejection, malformed input, unknown-GSTIN non-leaky 401, wrong-password 401, lockout after 10 fails + Mongo clear, session cookie -> /me + /retailer-dashboard/performance, duplicate-GSTIN register 409, ensure_gstin_usernames migration state, phone-OTP unaffected, handoff create+consume, D2C login untouched). Backend startup migration is idempotent: first run {aligned:7, deactivated:6}, all subsequent runs {aligned:0, deactivated:0}. Web UI verified: /retailer/login shows GSTIN label, placeholder 27ABCDE1234F1Z5, maxLength 15, lowercase input auto-uppercases, retailer-identifier-hint + retailer-password-help visible, login with 07AAAAA0000A1Z5/Test@12345 lands on /retailer/dashboard where 'Your login ID: 07AAAAA0000A1Z5' and sidebar-login-id chip both render. /retailer/register callout (register-gst-is-login-id) is hidden for '07AAA', shown with the full GSTIN text for '27ABCDE1234F1Z5'. Regression pages /retailer/onboarding, /products/royal-kewda, /products/kesar-chandan all return 200.
critical_code_review_comments: Client-side email/malformed toast on /retailer/login could not be captured by the Playwright toast selector after submit (empty text). Backend correctly rejects with the required 400 phrase, so UX fallback is not broken, but if a user pastes an email the UI should still surface a client-side toast reliably. Worth a quick e2e check with the actual toast implementation (e.g. Sonner) selector.
